name: status:ready
description: Unclaimed and unblocked: an agent may /claim it

name: status:in-progress
description: Claimed: an agent is working it (see the bot's claim comment)

name: status:in-review
description: A PR that closes this issue is open

name: status:changes-requested
description: Review sent the PR back: any worker may /claim it to fix the PR

name: status:blocked
description: Waiting on another issue (its Depends on: line) or a stated reason

name: status:needs-owner
description: Waiting on the owner's decision or action

name: type:bug
description: Something is wrong in the code

name: type:feature
description: New capability

name: type:chore
description: Maintenance with no behavior change

name: type:tech-debt
description: Structure or design debt that slows or endangers future work

name: type:security
description: Security weakness or hardening

name: type:test
description: Missing, weak, or broken tests

name: type:docs
description: Documentation

name: type:ops
description: Operations, deployment, infrastructure

name: type:research
description: Investigation whose output is a decision or new issues

name: type:epic
description: Parent issue grouping one outcome's tasks (sub-issues). Never claimed.

name: P0
description: Hard-rule breach, data loss, or broken trunk/CI: drop everything

name: P1
description: Blocks production use or onboarding a second company

name: P2
description: Important quality or reliability work

name: P3
description: Nice to have

name: size:S
description: Under 2 hours

name: size:M
description: About half a day

name: size:L
description: One to two days

name: size:XL
description: Too big: split it before anyone claims it

name: area:portal-bot
description: Playwright automation: learn, replay, recipes, capture

name: area:pipeline
description: Autopilot, jobs, scheduler, stage transitions

name: area:fees
description: Permit/interconnection fees, quotes, payment gates

name: area:kb-lookup
description: Knowledge base, per-job lookup, jurisdiction data

name: area:intake-parser
description: Plan-set parsing, intake, extraction

name: area:reviewer
description: QC and the reviewer gate

name: area:ahj-forms
description: AHJ form acquisition, mapping, filling

name: area:tenancy-auth
description: Orgs, clients, auth, entitlements, route scoping

name: area:security
description: Secrets, crypto, hardening

name: area:ops-deploy
description: Hosting, deploy, backups, monitoring

name: area:ci-test
description: CI, test runners, test infrastructure

name: area:frontend
description: Dashboard UI (frontend/)

name: area:docs
description: Documentation

name: area:billing
description: Invoicing and billing

name: bot-safe
description: Doable with local code and local tests alone: worker bots may claim it

name: owner-action
description: Only the owner can do this: live portal, credentials, or a business decision

name: safety-critical
description: Touches a hard safety rule: pinning test, lead review, and owner approval

name: owner-approved
description: The OWNER's sign-off on a safety-critical PR. Only the owner applies this.

name: owner-request
description: Filed by the owner: the lead turns it into tasks

name: owner-digest
description: The lead's running report to the owner

name: needs-triage
description: Filed without full labels: the lead triages it

name: first-wave
description: Picked for the first wave of worker bots

name: local-only
description: Needs the owner's machine or eyes: only worker-local (the owner's terminal) may claim it
